advanced.drPerformanceSubtitle: Visits, visit revenue, tests, test revenue, test commission, and hospital revenue per doctor.

table.feesCommissionTooltip: Sum of all commissions paid to this doctor during the period. Includes consultation, lab test, and referral commissions.
table.referralLabRevenueTooltip: Sum of bill revenue for bills linked to this doctor's referral commissions, excluding bills already counted in this doctor's visit-bill revenue. Offsets referral commissions so the net reflects actual hospital earnings.
table.hospitalRevenueTooltip: Visit revenue + test revenue + referred-lab bill revenue − total commissions. The headline net per-doctor hospital revenue.
table.netHospitalTooltip: Visit bill revenue + referred-lab bill revenue (for bills outside this doctor's own visits) − total commissions. Can still be negative when total commissions exceed the combined revenue streams this doctor accounts for.
table.netNegativeNote: Net is negative — commissions exceed the combined visit + referred-lab revenue for this doctor in the selected period.
